infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: UniBuzz uses your camera for video calls, and to take photos and record videos for posts, reels, Snaps and listings, like video tours of your place.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: UniBuzz shows your photos and videos so you can post them, and add them to listings and your profile.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: UniBuzz uses the microphone for audio and video calls, voice messages and video tours.
